name: When is it necessary to replace my deck versus repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to replace my deck versus repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck replacement is typically necessary when structural integrity is compromised due to widespread rot, significant insect damage, or severe wood deterioration that affects more than 25% of the deck's surface. Minor issues like a few loose boards, faded stain, or small areas of rot might be repairable. A professional inspection can determine if the frame, support posts, and ledger board are sound, which is a key factor in deciding between repair and full replacement. Hometelligent Inc. offers inspections in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville to assess the condition of your existing deck.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your deck when there's widespread structural damage; minor issues might allow for repairs. An inspection can confirm the best course of action.
